validation_scope: OOF schema/probabilities/prompt-fold consistency only; does not prove vectorizers were fit within training folds

family_diagnostics.note: Provider aggregation is diagnostic only; competition metric remains 18-class BA

length_quartiles.binning: pandas.qcut on all OOF training-text word counts; identical lengths stay together; duplicate edges dropped; diagnostic only

prompt_cluster_bootstrap.method: percentile prompt-cluster bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions
prompt_cluster_bootstrap.caveat: Approximate uncertainty conditional on fitted OOF models; does not measure retraining variance. Replicates lacking any legal class are excluded and counted.

resources.os_peak_rss_scope: process lifetime, not isolated to this phase
resources.gpu_note: CPU scikit-learn pipeline; GPU process memory was not measured
